attributes.name: Druva - Administrative Changes Outside Business Hours
attributes.description: Detects Druva administrative changes occurring outside the defined business-hours window. After-hours privileged changes may warrant additional review.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects Druva administrative changes occurring outside the defined business-hours window. After-hours privileged changes may warrant additional review.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type != "Admin Login"
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| EVAL event_hour = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", event_time)
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )
| WHERE event_hour < 7 OR event_hour >= 19
